I did a lot of meditation for many years - powerful stuff.

The existence of other dimensions is very real, and you can go there if you want to through meditation. I have heard you can fast track that process with DMT, though I have never tried that myself.

People pick up on it - and they are attracted to you - even as they do not know why. They are drawn to you. Sounds ridiculous, I know - but it is true - happens with the animals as well. Apparently it has something to do with changes to your aura that occur over time through the practice of meditation. Spiritually, I feel very powerful now - even today. Some humans can see it - and they freak out when they encounter you - which I always get a kick out of:)

Meditation definitely rewires certain neural pathways in your brain - and it promotes intense focus, and sometimes alters the perception of time and space. There is also a certain telepathic element to it. It also gives you the ability to observe yourself as if you are slightly above and outside of yourself - difficult to explain - the part of you that says I am me - the real you, your self awareness - that part can separate from the part of you that is controlled by emotions, etc - and observe the earth bound you in action. If you leave your body, it is the real you that leaves - the earthbound you stays here.

The inner universe is just as infinite as the outer universe, and perhaps even more so. I have barely scratched the surface of what exists there.

Using meditation, you can probably survive indefinite solitary confinement - because the walls and chains cannot restrain the real you from going anywhere you please.
